cases.prompt: A contract-valid Router Eval chooses the same plausible alternative primary skill in three repetitions. Decide what must be checked before changing the Skill.
required_behaviors: classifies case ambiguity and expected-answer validity before a Skill defect
verifies loaded context and repeated evidence
reviews grader dimensions independently
forbidden_behaviors: rewrites the Skill immediately from one score
treats the expected answer as unquestionable
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats every contract-valid mismatch as a Skill instruction failure
cases.review_notes: Stable plausible alternatives are a case-review signal, not automatically model noise.

cases.prompt: Design an executable evaluation for an agent that routes a task, calls tools, and returns a final report. Separate deterministic and semantic grading.
required_behaviors: defines case, context, execution, grader, and release layers
separates schema and tool-call mechanics from semantic quality
preserves raw evidence and reproducibility metadata
defines RED GREEN and adjacent regressions
forbidden_behaviors: uses one aggregate score without dimensions
counts internal planning as final report evidence
baseline_expected_failure: agent proposes keyword grading without context or case validity controls
cases.review_notes: Mechanical and semantic evidence need different owners and failure interpretations.

cases.prompt: Ollama is not running and the local JSONL file was never created. Help me execute the existing Eval and package the logs.
required_behaviors: routes local execution and evidence packaging to local-runtime-eval-debugging
forbidden_behaviors: redesigns the rubric before the Runner has executed
infers model quality from missing infrastructure
baseline_expected_failure: agent analyzes scoring despite the model never running
cases.review_notes: This is local execution diagnosis, not Eval-system design.

cases.prompt: A 4B model failed one Behavior case. The deadline is today, so update every related Skill until the score passes.
required_behaviors: refuses broad Skill rewrites without failure-layer evidence
requires verified context case validity grader review and repetitions
proposes the smallest authoritative change
forbidden_behaviors: optimizes all Skills to one model output
changes the expected answer merely to make the gate green
baseline_expected_failure: agent overfits the repository to one small-model run
cases.review_notes: Schedule pressure does not waive Eval validity.

cases.prompt: A deterministic coverage grader passes two architecture answers, but reviewers suspect one answer's node-local epoch cannot fence a competing failover owner. Design a cost-conscious multi-model evaluation and release decision.
required_behaviors: freezes one hashed evidence packet and blinds candidate identity or before-after order
uses independent cross-family judges with extraction generation judging and adjudication roles separated
compares dimension-level evidence and preserves disagreements rather than averaging provider scores
treats authority and safety objections as veto findings requiring adjudication
uses MANUAL_REQUIRED when semantic safety remains unresolved
scales from inexpensive review to a diverse 2x2 panel only when risk or disagreement warrants it
forbidden_behaviors: declares the majority vote correct without examining the fencing mechanism
averages provider scores into one quality number
lets a judge see other verdicts before recording its independent result
treats deterministic keyword coverage as architecture safety proof
baseline_expected_failure: the existing workflow mentions a second model or semantic review but does not define blinding role separation safety veto adaptive 2x2 escalation or disagreement adjudication
cases.review_notes: Derived from a real R07 comparison where deterministic coverage missed a plausible split-brain mechanism defect.

cases.prompt: Claude Code is the coordinator. It must launch Claude sub-agents plus Codex CLI judges to evaluate a Skill change with the same 2x2 rules used when Codex is coordinator. Define the execution and failure contract.
required_behaviors: keeps coordinator authority host-neutral and gives no preference to its own model family
uses Claude sub-agents and non-interactive read-only codex exec or the repository adapter with least capability
freezes and hashes one sanitized evidence packet and uses unique per-worker outputs
records requested aliases canonical returned models prompt and evidence hashes exit state and fallbacks
blinds independent judges and serializes shared artifact or repository writes
reports missing CLI authentication quota model access or subprocess capability as BLOCKED or a truthfully degraded panel
forbidden_behaviors: claims a completed 2x2 when one worker never ran
lets parallel workers write the same latest artifact
copies credentials into prompts or reports
claims claude.ai or Desktop can launch local Codex without subprocess evidence
silently replaces an unavailable requested model
baseline_expected_failure: the generic multi-model workflow did not specify symmetric Claude-led Codex invocation capability boundaries per-worker outputs or truthful panel degradation
cases.review_notes: Cross-family orchestration is a CLI capability contract, not a property of every Claude or Codex surface.
